notes: τήν of τὴν προσαγωγήν takes the supplied 'our' under rule 20's second arm: no genitive pronoun stands in the phrase to take the possessive.
τῇ πίστει → 'by faith' has no determiner, so the article is `unrepresented` and the case preposition stays with the noun (rules 21 and 23).
ἐν ᾗ → 'wherein' is one `aligned` portmanteau unit headed on the relative, since '-in' answers to ἐν (rule 35, not rule 45).
The 'by faith' clause is textually contested but stands in the projection and in the ASV text, so it is aligned normally (rule 12).
